第95章 江绍庭请跟我们走一趟-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

“那就去吧！”九面笑狐给了陈曹一个微笑，已经转身走出了草棚。

云浅直到躺到床上，眼睛还在观察这屋中的一切，大方简约又不失庄重优雅，云浅对记忆中的那个“父亲”忽然生出了一股好奇之心。

安凝起来后打算给我做早餐，我看了看时间有些来不及了就让安凝给自己做就好了，我洗漱完后给安凝打了个招呼就出门了。

“等等，你嘴巴上的伤不是他咬的。那那个男人是谁？你不要告诉我，你是自己咬的？”沈晓晓突然意识到这个问題，这个问題才是最重要的。

不过这些事却不能说出口，嘛，算了，走一步算一步吧，反正时间会证明一切。

随后道士帽又拉着胖子一起到棺材前恭恭敬敬的给磕了三个头，这样道士帽方才放下心来，继续着守灵。

叶辰初步断定，这水是透明的，并没有任何异常，大胆的叶辰竟然喝了几口，片刻时间也没有发现任何的不舒服。

警察总长只是简单的说了一句话之后，显示屏中的画面就立即转为了模糊，但是很显然，这并不是在作假，他的声音不大，但是很清晰，所有人都听的清清楚楚，这下连那个年轻的特警也没有了话说，微微的向后退了一步。

仔细一看，我便认出这五个“人”赫然就是我们之前看到的那五具尸体，看来这就是那五具尸体变成的活死人。

不过，现在也不能在这里待下去，这里的目标已经暴露了，到时候会引来大批的佣兵进行追堵，他和花佛都明白，那些佣兵比起土著士兵来，土著士兵的那些手段看起来简直就像是绅士。

后者容貌更胜一筹，在曾季安没有具体品级的情况下，也获封宝林，入主鹤首居。

只是她很清楚自己中计了，江淮既然随身带着那信，就说明……这一切都是江淮和庞密的套，是专门给她做的套。

横山指了两个士兵吩咐道。然后看着攻过来的人族士兵说：“族人们做好准备，生死就在这场战争了！”然后拿起弓箭瞄准红猪，射了出去。

十道穿着黑色王袍的身影立于校场之上，在他们的背后乃是地府众神。

"Then let's go!" The nine-faced smiling fox gave Chen Cao a smile and turned around and walked out of the hut.

Until Yun Qian lay down on the bed, her eyes were still observing everything in this room. It was simple, yet solemn and elegant. Yun Qian suddenly became curious about the "father" in his memory.

After An Ning got up, she planned to make breakfast for me. I looked at the time and it was too late, so I just asked An Ning to cook it for me. After I washed up, I said hello to An Ning and went out.

"Wait a minute, the wound on your mouth was not bitten by him. Who is that man? Don't tell me, you bit it yourself?" Shen Xiaoxiao suddenly realized this problem, and this question is the most important.

But these things cannot be said out loud, well, forget it, just take it one step at a time, time will prove everything anyway.

Then Taoist Mao took the fat man to the coffin and kowtowed three times respectfully. Only then did Taoist Mao feel at ease and continue to keep vigil.

Ye Chen initially concluded that the water was transparent and there was nothing abnormal about it. The brave Ye Chen actually took a few sips and did not notice any discomfort for a moment.

After the police chief simply said a word, the picture on the display screen immediately turned blurry, but it was obvious that this was not a lie. His voice was not loud, but it was very clear, and everyone could hear it clearly. Even the young special police officer was speechless and took a step back slightly.

After a closer look, I recognized that these five "people" were the five corpses we saw before. It seemed that these were the living dead that those five corpses had turned into.

However, he cannot stay here now. The target here has been exposed, and a large number of mercenaries will be attracted to pursue him. Both he and Hua Buddha understand that compared with the indigenous soldiers, the methods of the mercenaries look like gentlemen.

The latter's appearance was even better, and even though Zeng Ji'an had no specific rank, he was awarded the title of Baolin and entered the first place of the crane.

But she knew very well that she had fallen into a trap. Since Jiang Huai carried the letter with him, it meant that... all of this was a trap by Jiang Huai and Pang Mi, a trap specially made for her.

Hengshan pointed at the two soldiers and ordered.Then he looked at the attacking human soldiers and said, "People, get ready, life and death depend on this war!" Then he picked up his bow and arrow, aimed at the red pig, and shot it.

Ten figures wearing black royal robes stood on the school grounds, and behind them were the gods of the underworld.
